ab:
A quick bite using your tusks that deals small damage but has a very quick cooldown.
Deals 35 damage.

Your immune system is 43 million years ahead of the rest. 
-50% incoming Venom, Poison and Toxin.
Able to eat berries and fruit. Reduced water drain.

+5% armor for each Paraceratherium nearby. 4 stacks maximum.
+5% additional armor if there is one 'Herd Leader' Paraceratherium nearby.
Disabled if there is more than one 'Herd Leader', giving a debuff instead:
-5% armor. -10% damage towards other Paraceratheriums.

Your heart beats with warm blood, increasing your endurance.
Grants +2% movement speed, +4% stamina recovery and a -8% decreased sprinting stamina cost per stack.
Get consistent hits to gain stacks of Running Tempo. 
You will lose stacks if you miss an attack or get hit.
Kicks cost more stamina, but you regain stamina upon landing a successful hit.

Kick with both your hind legs, dealing high damage and knockback.
Deals 90 damage.

Stomp the ground with one back leg depending on the direction you are facing. Deals damage in a small area of effect. You can move while attacking, but you will be slowed down.
Deals 80 damage.

Knockback attacks deal increased damage, but less knockback.
+15% Damage, -40% Knockback Force.

Able to eat Berries, Roots and Nuts. 
Increased food depletion rate. 
Increased Health Recovery.
+20% health recovery.

Charge forward in a line, causing damage to anything you hit, and dealing knockback.
Deals 100 damage.

Increases the damage and knockback of the charge attack. 
Landing a charge will gain you 10 Running Tempo stacks.
+25% Damage, +100% Knockback.

Knockback attacks deal increased knockback, but less damage. 
+50% Knockback, -10% Damage.

Your hunger lasts longer, but you require overall more food. 
You can eat berries and fruit.
Provides increased combat weight, and decreased speed.
+5% combat weight, -10% speed.

Kick with both your front legs, dealing damage and some knockback.
Deals 60 damage.

Fight head-on.
+15% Front-facing damage, -10% Back-facing damage. 
Bite now applies the 'Scraped' effect, which reduces stamina regeneration on your opponent per each stack.

Activate to stand up on two legs, and release to slam the ground dealing damage in a large area of effect. 
Deals up to 140 damage.

Your snout flushes red. Shows your position as the herd leader.
+5% armor and +5% damage per nearby Paraceratherium.
Conflicts if there is another 'Herd Leader' Paraceratherium nearby:
-5% armor and -5% damage. +20% damage towards other Paraceratheriums.

Clean friendly creatures to grant them a healing buff. 
Consumes a small amount of water when used.
Applies a healing buff to creatures in your group.
+100% Bleed Healing, +300% Health Recovery, +100% Stamina Recovery.
Applies a speed debuff to creatures outside your group.
-20% Speed, +10% Stamina Sprint Cost.

You gain +5% armor when there is no other Paraceratherium nearby.
-5% Armor when there are other Paraceratherium nearby.
+5% Damage towards other Paraceratherium.

Knock the wind out of your enemies. Stomp & Heavy Slam deal additional damage and take away stamina from your opponent.
+10% damage, +5 stamina damage.

Swing your neck to hit enemies, dealing damage and knockback but with a high cooldown.
Deals 60 damage.

Gain armor based on your movement speed. 
Scales from -10% armor when standing still to +50% Armor when running. 
Armor can exceed this value when exceeding maximum running speed.

Increases the area of effect radius of the Heavy Slam & Stomp attacks. 
+40% AoE radius.

Stomp the ground with one front leg depending on the direction you are facing. Deals damage in a small area of effect. You can move while attacking, but you will be slowed down.
Deals 80 damage.

Become enraged when you miss a stomp, reducing its cooldown, but calming down upon landing a hit and increasing it instead. 
Increases your trample damage for each stack of Running Tempo.
-80% Cooldown on miss, +100% Cooldown on hit. +10% trample damage per stack of Running Tempo.

Brush yourself with your tail. 
Grants you 4 stacks of Running Tempo.
These stacks can exceed the normal amount of maximum stacks.
Applies the 'Itch Scratched' effect, which shortly provides a 1% turning radius bonus for each stack of Running Tempo.

Slightly increases your turning radius, and massively increases your charge turning radius. Reduces Charge cooldown.
+2.5% Turn radius, +100% Charge turn radius, -25% Charge cooldown.

Decreases Charge stamina consumption and increases the maximum duration. 
Provides knockback resistance when charging.
-40% Charge cost, +200% Duration.
